Why Mesh?

The Mesh team is a group of innovators and leaders on a mission to make payments smarter, smoother, and more secure. We believe in building a transparent and dynamic world, and we highly invest in our people, customers and product.

We have a flexible work model, connecting people from multiple locations including the US, Europe, and Tel Aviv. We’re rapidly growing and always looking for talented people to be part of the Mesh team to help shape our product and culture
